section.title: Heading of Settings › People: the list of human accounts on this workspace, as admins manage them.
section.description: Text under the heading of Settings › People: the list shows who can sign in, their role and what they can reach; opening a person shows their full page.
section.invite: Button on Settings › People: opens the dialog that adds a person to the workspace.
section.tabs.people: Tab on Settings › People: the table of human accounts.
section.tabs.groups: Tab on Settings › People: groups that give people extra permissions.
section.tabs.serviceAccounts: Tab on Settings › People: service accounts, non-human accounts that scripts and tools use.
section.tabs.withCount: A tab's name with how many items it holds, such as "People · 3". {{tab}} is the tab's translated name.
section.groupsNeedSignIn: "Better Auth" is the sign-in library's name; don't translate it. "The local picker" is the development sign-in that lists test users.
section.loadFailed: Error toast on Settings › People when the list of people can't be loaded and the server gave no message.
roles.admin: A workspace role: admins manage the whole workspace. Shown in the role picker and filters.
roles.member: A workspace role: everyone who isn't an admin.
state.active: Status badge: the person has signed in and can sign in.
state.invited: Status badge: the person was added but hasn't signed in yet.
state.invite-expired: Status badge: the person was invited, but their invite link expired before they used it.
state.deactivated: Status badge: the account can't sign in any more; its work stays.
lastActive.never: Last active value when the person has never been active. Short, for a table cell.
lastActive.now: How long ago the person was last active, in a table cell: keep it short. The _inline forms are used inside a sentence ("last used now"), so they start lowercase in English.
lastActive.minutes: Minutes since last activity, abbreviated ("25 min ago"). Always 10 or more.
lastActive.hours: Hours since last activity, abbreviated ("3 h ago").
lastActive.yesterday: Last active value: the person was last active yesterday. The _inline form is used inside a sentence, so it starts lowercase in English.
lastActive.days: Last active value, for a table cell: how many days ago; {{count}} is the number of days.
lastActive.weeks: Last active value, for a table cell: how many weeks ago; {{count}} is the number of weeks.
lastActive.date: A date this year, without the year ("Oct 2").
lastActive.dateYear: A date in an earlier year ("Oct 2, 2025").
lastActive.exact: The exact moment, to the second, in a tooltip or a small note.
devices: How many devices (browsers, phones) the person is signed in on.
unknownDevice: Stands in for a signed-in device's name when its browser or system can't be told, on a person's Sign-in & devices tab.
signIn.cantSignIn: Value of the "Signs in with" column when the account can't sign in (it is deactivated).
signIn.passkey: A sign-in method chip: their passkeys; with more than one, the count after a multiplication sign ("Passkey ×2").
signIn.password: A sign-in method chip in the "Signs in with" column: the person has a password.
signIn.passwordOnly: A warning chip: a password is their only way to sign in (no passkey or provider).
signIn.nothing: Value of the "Signs in with" column when the person has no password, passkey or provider yet.
signIn.telegram: A sign-in method chip: they get sign-in links on Telegram (a messaging app; keep its name).
signIn.method.link: How a session signed in: with a one-time sign-in link.
signIn.method.linkEmail: How a session signed in: with a one-time sign-in link sent by email.
signInLink.action: An admin sends the person a one-time sign-in link, by email or on Telegram (a messaging app; keep its name). {{name}} is the person's name.
reach.spaces: What the person can reach, in a narrow table cell, joined with " · ": "5 Spaces · 3 socios · 2 apps · code". A Space is a product noun (a shared area of pages and chats); a socio is an AI agent; an agent here is an outside AI agent they connected.
reach.code: Short for "may run code" (coding sessions), the last item of the reach list.
reach.ownsApps: A deactivated person's reach: the mini apps they still own.
ownerLock.others: Tooltip on a disabled control: the workspace owner's account is protected, and only the owner changes it.
ownerLock.self: Tooltip on a disabled control on the owner's own account: the workspace owner stays an active admin, so they must make another admin the owner first. No final period in English.
owner.badge: Badge beside the workspace owner's name: the one admin other admins can't demote or remove.
role.label: Accessible name of a person's role picker. {{name}} is the person's name.
role.byRule: Tooltip: the person is an admin because the server's AUTH_ADMIN_EMAILS setting lists their email. Keep AUTH_ADMIN_EMAILS as is.
role.changeFailed: Error toast when changing a person's role (from the list or their page) failed and the server gave no message.
demote.title: Confirmation before an admin is made a member. The _admin and _member forms are the role it changes to.
demote.loses: What the person loses when made a member. {{first}} is their first name.
releases.title: Dialog title: the release notes this person has opened. {{name}} is the person's name.
actions.passwordLink: Makes a one-time link that sets or resets the person's password, for the admin to send them.
list.toolbar: Accessible name of the search and filter bar above the people table.
list.expired: Callout above the table: invites that expired unused, followed by each person's name and a Password link button.
list.columns.reach: Column header: what each person can reach (Spaces, socios, apps).
passwordLink.for: {{email}} is the person's email; {{until}} the link's expiry, with date and time. The _emailed form also says the link went out by email.
invite.existing: An option to link an app user that has no account yet: their name and, in parentheses, their user id.
groups.intro: Groups give extra permissions to people who aren't admins. "Run code" is the only permission for now.
groups.permissions.code-run.detail: "Gateways" are the coding proxies Socio runs for AI models and Git; keep "Git" as is.
groups.card.deactivated: Appended after a group member's email when their account is deactivated. Starts with a separator.
groups.card.option: An option in the "add a person" list: name and email; the _admin form marks admins.
groups.delete.loses: Confirmation body: how many group members lose the group's permissions when it is deleted.
signIn.method.password: How a session signed in, on a person's Sign-in & devices tab: with their password.
signIn.method.passkey: How a session signed in, on a person's Sign-in & devices tab: with a passkey (a WebAuthn credential on their device).
signInLink.sent: Toast after a one-time sign-in link was sent; {{name}} is the person's name. The _email and _telegram forms say how it was sent.
signInLink.failed: Error toast when sending a person a one-time sign-in link (from the people list or a person's page) failed and the server gave no message.
reach.nothing: Value of the "Can reach" column for a deactivated person who owns no apps.
reach.nothingYet: Value of the "Can reach" column when the person can reach no Spaces, socios, apps or code yet.
reach.socios: Part of the "Can reach" list: how many socios (AI agents) the person let act for them; {{count}} is that number.
reach.agents: Part of the "Can reach" list: how many outside AI agents (connected agents) act for the person; {{count}} is that number.
reach.apps: Part of the "Can reach" list: how many apps the person owns; {{count}} is that number.
reach.keysMade: Part of the "Can reach" list: how many live service account keys the person made; {{count}} is that number.
owner.title: Tooltip on the Owner badge.
role.reactivateFirst: Tooltip on a deactivated person's disabled role picker.
demote.confirm: Button in the confirmation dialog that changes the person's role; the _admin form makes them an admin, the _member form a member.
demote.cancel: Button that closes the role change confirmation without changing the role.
releases.action: Item in a person's actions menu: opens the list of release notes this person has opened.
actions.open: Item in a person's actions menu in the people table: opens that person's own page.
actions.reactivate: Item in a deactivated person's actions menu: opens the confirmation to let them sign in again.
actions.signOutEverywhere: Item in a person's actions menu: ends all of that person's sessions on every device.
actions.deactivate: Destructive item in a person's actions menu: opens the confirmation to stop the account from signing in; its work stays.
actions.passwordLinkFailed: Error toast when making a one-time password link for a person failed and the server gave no message.
actions.signedOut: Toast after the admin signed a person out everywhere; {{name}} is the person's name.
actions.signOutFailed: Error toast when signing a person out on every device failed and the server gave no message.
actions.deactivated: Toast after an account was deactivated; {{name}} is the person's name.
actions.deactivateFailed: Error toast after the deactivate confirmation when deactivating the account failed and the server gave no message.
actions.reactivated: Toast after an account was reactivated; {{name}} is the person's name.
actions.reactivateFailed: Error toast after the reactivate confirmation when reactivating the account failed and the server gave no message.
list.search: Placeholder of the search box above the people table.
list.roleFilter: Accessible name of the role filter select above the people table.
list.roleAny: Option of the role filter: show every role.
list.statusFilter: Accessible name of the status filter select above the people table.
list.statusAny: Option of the status filter: show every status.
list.loading: Shown while the people table loads.
list.noMatch: Shown when no person matches the search or filters.
list.empty: Shown when the workspace has no people yet.
list.label: Accessible name of the people table (read by screen readers).
list.columns.person: Column header: each person's name and email.
list.columns.role: Column header: each person's workspace role (Admin or Member).
list.columns.status: Column header: each account's status (Active, Invited, Deactivated…).
list.columns.lastActive: Column header: how long ago each person was last active.
list.columns.signIn: Column header: the ways each person can sign in (password, passkey, provider…).
passwordLink.title: Title of the dialog showing a one-time link that sets or resets a person's password.
passwordLink.description: Body of the password link dialog: the link sets or resets the person's password, and a newer link replaces this one.
passwordLink.field: Accessible name of the field holding the password link.
passwordLink.copy: Button: copies the password link to the clipboard.
passwordLink.copied: Toast after the password link was copied.
passwordLink.done: Button that closes the password link dialog.
invite.title: Title of the dialog that adds a person to the workspace.
invite.description: Body of the dialog that adds a person: the admin picks a role, gets a password link to send, and the person sets a password and signs in.
invite.form: Accessible name of the form in the Invite people dialog.
invite.name: Accessible name of the field for the new person's name.
invite.namePlaceholder: Placeholder of the new person's name field.
invite.email: Accessible name of the field for the new person's email address.
invite.emailPlaceholder: Placeholder of the new person's email field.
invite.role: Accessible name of the select of the new person's role.
invite.link: Accessible name of the select that links the new account to an existing app user who has no account yet.
invite.newUser: Default option of that select: make a new user instead of linking an existing one.
invite.cancel: Button that closes the Invite people dialog without adding anyone.
invite.done: Button that closes the Invite people dialog once the password link is shown.
invite.submit: Button that adds the person and makes their password link.
invite.added: Toast after a person was added; {{name}} is their name.
invite.failed: Error toast in the add-person dialog when adding the account failed and the server gave no message.
groups.new: Button on the Groups tab: opens the dialog that creates a group.
groups.empty: Shown on the Groups tab of Settings › People when there are no groups; a group can let people who aren't admins run code.
groups.loadFailed: Error toast on the Groups tab when the list of groups can't be loaded and the server gave no message.
groups.noPermissions: Shown on a group's card when the group gives no permissions.
groups.permissions.code-run.label: A permission a group can give: starting coding sessions where code runs.
groups.dialog.editTitle: Title of the dialog that edits a group; {{name}} is the group's name.
groups.dialog.newTitle: Title of the dialog that creates a group.
groups.dialog.description: Body of the dialog that creates or edits a group: every member gets the group's permissions; admins have all permissions anyway.
groups.dialog.editForm: Accessible name of the form editing a group.
groups.dialog.newForm: Accessible name of the form creating a group.
groups.dialog.name: Label of the group name field.
groups.dialog.namePlaceholder: Placeholder of the group name field.
groups.dialog.permissions: Heading of the checkboxes of permissions the group gives.
groups.dialog.cancel: Button that closes the group dialog without saving.
groups.dialog.save: Button that saves the changes to an existing group.
groups.dialog.create: Button that creates the new group.
groups.dialog.saved: Toast after a group's changes saved.
groups.dialog.created: Toast after a group was created; {{name}} is its name.
groups.dialog.saveFailed: Error toast in the group dialog when saving or creating the group failed and the server gave no message.
groups.card.label: Accessible name of a group's card; {{name}} is the group's name.
groups.card.edit: Button on a group's card: opens the dialog that edits the group.
groups.card.delete: Button on a group's card: deletes the group (after a confirmation).
groups.card.members: Accessible name of the list of people in a group; {{name}} is the group's name.
groups.card.remove: Button beside a group member: takes that person out of the group.
groups.card.nobody: Shown on a group's card when nobody is in it.
groups.card.addForm: Accessible name of the form that adds a person to a group; {{name}} is the group's name.
groups.card.addSelect: Accessible name of the select of the person to add; {{name}} is the group's name.
groups.card.choose: Placeholder option of the select of the person to add to a group.
groups.card.add: Button: adds the chosen person to the group.
groups.card.addFailed: Error after adding a person to a group failed.
groups.card.removeFailed: Error after taking a person out of a group failed.
groups.delete.title: Title of the confirmation dialog before deleting a group; {{name}} is the group's name.
groups.delete.nobody: In the delete confirmation: the group has no members, so nobody loses anything.
groups.delete.deleted: Toast after a group was deleted; {{name}} is its name.
groups.delete.failed: Error toast after the delete confirmation when deleting a group failed and the server gave no message.
